title: PCSO provides wheelchairs to PWDs, other residents in Pateros

blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) provided wheelchairs to the Municipality of Pateros to assist Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) and other residents in need, following the request of Mayor Gerald S. German. The wheelchairs were formally turned over by PCSO Executive Assistant Atty. Maria Katrina Nicole Ventanilla to Maria Ruby D. Incon, Head of the Public Assistance Center (PAC), who received the assistance on behalf of Mayor German during a ceremony on September 22,2026, at the PCSO Main Office in Mandaluyong City. The assistance forms part of PCSO’s Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) efforts to extend support to communities and provide assistance […]...
